styleStep.title: What kind of song do you want to create?
styleStep.subtitle: Choose a style that matches your vision

chordStep.title: Choose a Chord Progression
chordStep.subtitle: This defines the emotional feel of your song

settingsStep.title: Set Key & Tempo
settingsStep.subtitle: Fine-tune the feel of your song

key.label: Key
key.description: Choose the key signature. Click to hear the scale

tempo.label: Tempo (BPM)
tempo.description: Beats per minute. Higher = faster tempo

duration.label: Target Duration
duration.description: Set the approximate length of your song

rack.statusDefault: Hover over a parameter for details

humanize.label: Humanize
humanize.description: Add natural human-like imperfections to timing and dynamics. Makes MIDI sound less mechanical and more like a real performance.
humanize.timingHint: How much notes deviate from perfect grid timing

compositionStyle.label: Composition Style
compositionStyle.description: What role should the melody play in the track?

options.melodyLeadDesc: Melody takes center stage, prominent and memorable
options.backgroundMotifDesc: Subtle melodic elements that support the track

motifSettings.label: Motif Settings
motifSettings.fixedProgressionDesc: Use the same chord progression across all sections

growthOptions.layerAddDesc: Add new parts as sections progress
growthOptions.registerAddDesc: Expand range within the same parts

drums.label: Drums
drums.description: Enable drum track for rhythm backing

arpeggio.label: Arpeggio
arpeggio.description: Break chords into individual notes played in sequence. Creates movement and texture in the accompaniment.
arpeggio.speedHint: How fast the notes are played
arpeggio.octaveRangeHint: How many octaves the pattern spans
arpeggio.syncChordDesc: Reset arpeggio pattern on chord changes
arpeggio.synthDrivenNote: Arpeggio is always enabled when using Synth Driven composition style.

chordExt.label: Chord Extensions
chordExt.desc1: Multiple can be enabled, but only one applies per chord
chordExt.susDesc: Replace the 3rd with 2nd or 4th. Creates tension and an open, unresolved feeling.
chordExt.seventhDesc: Add the 7th degree. Brings jazzy warmth and sophistication.
chordExt.ninthDesc: Add the 9th degree. Rich, dreamy sound popular in modern pop and R&B.

modulation.description: Add key changes (modulation) to create musical tension and excitement. Common in J-POP and anime songs.
modulation.semitonesHint: How many semitones to raise the key (+1 to +4)

se.description: Add call patterns for live performance feel. Perfect for idol and concert-style tracks.
se.callEnabledDesc: Add audience call patterns (Hai!, Fu!, etc.)
se.introChantDesc: Inserts a chant section right after the intro
se.mixPatternDesc: Inserts a MIX break section into the song
se.callDensityDesc: Frequency of 'Hai!' calls in chorus sections

bgmStep.title: Backing Track
bgmStep.subtitle: Review chords, bass, drums and arpeggio

result.hint: Listen to the backing track and proceed to melody generation

error.noBgm: Please generate the backing track first

melodyTemplate.label: Melody Type
melodyTemplate.description: Select a melodic shape pattern. Each pattern creates a distinct musical character

options.autoDesc: Automatically select based on section and style
options.plateauTalkDesc: Talk-sing style with same-note retention (NewJeans, Billie Eilish)
options.runUpTargetDesc: Ascending melody building to target pitch (YOASOBI, Ado)
options.hookRepeatDesc: Short catchy hooks with high repetition (TikTok, K-POP)
options.sparseAnchorDesc: Sparse anchored notes with breathing room (Official髭男dism)
options.jumpAccentDesc: Emotional peaks with dramatic interval jumps

vocalRange.label: Vocal Range
vocalRange.description: Set the pitch range for the melody

vocalAttitude.label: Vocal Attitude
vocalAttitude.description: How expressive should the melody be?

options.cleanDesc: Precise, controlled style with stable pitch

compositionStyle.label: Composition Style
compositionStyle.description: What role should the melody play?

options.melodyLeadDesc: Melody takes center stage, prominent and memorable
options.backgroundMotifDesc: Subtle melodic elements that support the track

vocalStyle.label: Vocal Style
vocalStyle.description: Select a style to auto-adjust note density, rhythm patterns, and pitch leaps
vocalStyle.implicitNote: ※ Internal parameters are automatically set based on the selected style

options.autoDesc: Automatically selected based on the style preset
options.vocaloidDesc: 16th-note heavy, fast passages, pitch leaps allowed
options.ultraVocaloidDesc: 32nd notes, ultra-dense, extreme leaps OK, no rests
options.idolDesc: 8th-note based, catchy hooks, chorus builds up
options.balladDesc: Quarter-note focused, relaxed, long notes, narrow range
options.rockDesc: Powerful hooks, syncopation, range rises in chorus
options.cityPopDesc: Stylish syncopation, tension notes, sophisticated melody
options.animeDesc: Catchy hooks, chorus builds up, dramatic
options.brightKiraDesc: Bright and sparkling, shifts to high range in chorus
options.coolSynthDesc: 16th-note heavy, cool synth style, no long notes
options.cuteAffectedDesc: Cute and charming, subtle syncopation, rises a bit in chorus
options.powerfulShoutDesc: Powerful vocals, quarter-note focused, denser in chorus

vocalGroove.label: Vocal Groove
vocalGroove.description: Set the rhythmic feel. Swing and off-beat change the groove

melodicComplexity.label: Melodic Complexity
melodicComplexity.description: Set the complexity of the melody. Simpler melodies are more memorable, complex ones have more variation

hookIntensity.label: Hook Intensity
hookIntensity.description: Set the strength of catchy hooks and memorable phrases. Stronger hooks are more ear-catching

finalStep.title: Complete!
finalStep.subtitle: Preview your finished track with melody
finalStep.hint: Go back to change settings if you're not satisfied

error.noInstance: Generation instance not found. Please restart from BGM step

summary.title: Current Settings
summary.noteFromStyle: From style: Note density and rhythm patterns auto-adjusted
summary.noteFromComplexity: From complexity: Note density and leap range adjusted
summary.noteFromGroove: From groove: Swing and syncopation feel applied

vocalDetail.title: Vocal Detail Settings
vocalDetail.description: Fine-tune detailed parameters. Custom settings override style preset defaults.

density.label: Note Density
density.hint: Controls how many notes are generated. Higher values create busier, more complex melodies.

division.label: Minimum Note Division
division.hint: The shortest note length allowed. Smaller divisions enable faster passages.

rest.label: Rest Ratio
rest.hint: Percentage of time allocated to rests between phrases. Higher values create more breathing room.

extremeLeap.label: Allow Extreme Leaps
extremeLeap.hint: Enable large pitch jumps for dramatic, vocaloid-style melodies.

style.label: Vocal Style
style.hint: Choose a rhythm pattern style for the vocal melody.

groove.label: Vocal Groove
groove.hint: Set the rhythmic feel of the vocal melody.
